_comment: MQ-3 ambient-capture precision/recall corpus (road-test #488, plans/ambient-capture.md §MQ-3). Each case labels a message with the CaptureOutcome ambient capture SHOULD reach: EXPLICIT_FIXATION (a record-me cue present), IMPORTANT_INFERRED (a durable fact worth keeping, no cue), or TRIVIAL (operational / small-talk / one-off / question / command). Extend it with real mis-classified messages as they surface; GoldenAmbientPrecisionTest scores the extractor against these labels.
